---
title: "Fine-tune set: transition states"
---

A second, separate set of frames from the transition-state region of
point-defect processes in graphene. These are vacancy hops and coalescence,
Stone–Wales formation and other bond rotations near defects, adatom hops, and
recombination of adatoms with vacancies, on strained and rippled sheets,
nanotubes and C60. The [first set](../index.qmd) samples starting structures,
relaxations, minima and MD up to 2000 K. Those trajectories are too short to
cross barriers of 1 eV or more, so the first set contains no transition states.

One model, MACE-OMAT-0 small, relaxes the end states and runs a climbing-image
NEB for each process. The same 21-member committee then scores the climbing
images, their neighbouring images and displaced copies by force and barrier
disagreement. A diversity-weighted selection reduces them to 500–1,000 frames.

{{< include steps/_ts_overview_status.md >}}

## Steps

1. [Processes and end states](steps/01_processes.qmd): the processes,
   frameworks, strain and curvature, and how each pair of end states is built.
2. [End states and NEB](steps/02_neb.qmd): the generator model, the batched
   relaxation and NEB, the corrections found in testing (rigid drift,
   runaway climbing images, states below both end states), and the
   barriers.
3. [Committee evaluation](steps/03_committee.qmd): the candidate frames, force
   spread and barrier spread, and each member's barriers relative to the
   committee.
4. [Selection](steps/04_selection.qmd): score, diversity, limits per band, the
   stopping rule and the output files.

## Files

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `ts/finetune_ts_selected.extxyz` | The selected transition-state frames (the deliverable) |
| `ts/ts_endpoints.extxyz` | Relaxed end states of the bands with selected frames, for barrier checks |
| `ts/candidate_scores.csv.gz` | Disagreement scores for every candidate frame |
| `ts/barriers.csv.gz` | Each member's forward barrier on every converged band |
| `ts/config.json` | Relaxation, NEB and candidate settings |
| `ts/pairs_summary.json`, `ts/candidates_summary.json`, `ts/selection_summary.json` | Counts at each step |
| `ts/work/` (ignored by git) | Pairs, end states, bands, candidates and committee predictions |

The [README](README.md) lists the commands that reproduce each step.
